# buildkite_test_suite_workflow (Resource)

Manages a Test Engine workflow. Requires the workflows API, `read_suites` and `write_suites` scopes, and suite-edit permission. Available monitors and actions depend on the organization's plan and integrations.

Configuration changes replace the workflow. Import is not supported.

Sensitive values remain in Terraform state. Refresh fails if webhook endpoints are masked.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "buildkite_test_suite" "application" {
  slug = "application"
}

resource "buildkite_test_suite_workflow" "flaky" {
  test_suite_uuid = data.buildkite_test_suite.application.uuid

  monitor = {
    type              = "transition_count"
    window_size       = 100
    alarm_threshold   = 0.05
    recover_threshold = 0
  }

  filters = [
    { key = "scm.branch", operator = "is", value = "main" }
  ]

  alarm_actions = [
    { type = "add_label", label = "flaky" }
  ]

  recover_actions = [
    { type = "remove_label", label = "flaky" }
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `monitor` (Attributes) Monitor settings. Supply all fields for the selected type. Recovery thresholds must be below alarm thresholds. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--monitor))
- `test_suite_uuid` (String) Suite UUID, such as `buildkite_test_suite.example.uuid`, not its GraphQL ID or slug.

### Optional

- `alarm_actions` (Attributes Set) Actions. Defaults to empty. Supply only the fields required by each action type. Maximum 7 entries. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--alarm_actions))
- `filters` (Attributes Set) Tag filters. Defaults to empty. `transition_count` requires a nonblank `scm.branch` filter; no default-branch filter is added. Maximum 4 entries. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filters))
- `recover_actions` (Attributes Set) Actions. Defaults to empty. Supply only the fields required by each action type. Maximum 7 entries. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--recover_actions))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The workflow UUID.
- `url` (String) The workflow's REST API URL.
- `web_url` (String) The workflow's browser URL.

<a id="nestedatt--monitor"></a>
### Nested Schema for `monitor`

Required:

- `type` (String) One of `transition_count`, `probabilistic_flakiness`, `duration_threshold`, `passed_on_retry`, or `new_test`. `new_test` requires an existing run and cannot have recovery actions.

Optional:

- `aggregation` (String) Duration aggregation. Only `p50` is supported.
- `alarm_threshold` (Number) Score alarm threshold, from 0 to 1. Minimum 0.025 for probabilistic flakiness. Transition-count scores allow at most three decimal places.
- `alarm_threshold_ms` (Number) Duration alarm threshold in integer milliseconds, from 0 to 3600000.
- `evaluation_window` (Number) Duration evaluation window, from 1 to 100.
- `recover_threshold` (Number) Score recovery threshold, from 0 to 1. Transition-count scores allow at most three decimal places.
- `recover_threshold_ms` (Number) Duration recovery threshold in integer milliseconds, from 0 to 3600000.
- `window_size` (Number) Transition-count window size, from 2 to 1000.


<a id="nestedatt--alarm_actions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `alarm_actions`

Required:

- `type` (String) One of `add_label`, `remove_label`, `change_state`, `send_webhook_notification`, `send_slack_notification`, or `create_linear_issue`.

Optional:

- `channel` (String, Sensitive) Slack channel.
- `description_template` (String, Sensitive) Linear issue description Liquid template.
- `endpoint` (String, Sensitive) Webhook HTTP(S) URL, at most 2048 characters.
- `label` (String) Normalized label name for label actions. Missing labels are created by the API.
- `linear_team_id` (String) Team UUID from Linear, accessible to the organization's integration.
- `message_template` (String, Sensitive) Slack Liquid message template, maximum 1000 characters.
- `slack_workspace_id` (String) Slack notification service UUID from the notification services API (`read_notification_services` scope), not a native Slack ID.
- `state` (String) Test state for `change_state`. Requires state management on the suite.
- `title_template` (String, Sensitive) Linear issue title Liquid template.


<a id="nestedatt--filters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filters`

Required:

- `key` (String) Tag key: at most 64 bytes, starting with a letter. Cannot be `mut` or start with `mut.`.
- `operator` (String) One of `is`, `is_not`, or `starts_with`.
- `value` (String) Nonempty tag value, at most 128 bytes, with no surrounding whitespace.


<a id="nestedatt--recover_actions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `recover_actions`

Required:

- `type` (String) One of `add_label`, `remove_label`, `change_state`, `send_webhook_notification`, `send_slack_notification`, or `create_linear_issue`.

Optional:

- `channel` (String, Sensitive) Slack channel.
- `description_template` (String, Sensitive) Linear issue description Liquid template.
- `endpoint` (String, Sensitive) Webhook HTTP(S) URL, at most 2048 characters.
- `label` (String) Normalized label name for label actions. Missing labels are created by the API.
- `linear_team_id` (String) Team UUID from Linear, accessible to the organization's integration.
- `message_template` (String, Sensitive) Slack Liquid message template, maximum 1000 characters.
- `slack_workspace_id` (String) Slack notification service UUID from the notification services API (`read_notification_services` scope), not a native Slack ID.
- `state` (String) Test state for `change_state`. Requires state management on the suite.
- `title_template` (String, Sensitive) Linear issue title Liquid template.
